title: Wirecard Explained: The €1.9 Billion That Never Existed
description:
In 2018, Wirecard was worth more than Deutsche Bank. Two years later, €1.9 billion of its cash turned out not to exist — and its COO vanished.

This is the story of Germany's biggest corporate fraud scandal: how a small Munich payments company became a DAX tech star, how the regulator went after the journalists instead of the company, how the money disappeared, and where the trial of Markus Braun stands today.
